item.title: Best Restaurants in Kanagawa: Yokohama, Kamakura & Beyond
item.description: Kanagawa’s food scene is one of the most distinctive in Japan, shaped by the prefecture’s dual identity as an ancient capital and a 19th-century international port. This is the birthplace of Japan’s most copied ramen style, the home of the country’s largest Chinatown, and the region where the Japanese Navy invented curry as we know it. Eating your way through Kanagawa is a journey through modern Japanese food history. Ie-kei Ramen (家系ラーメン) — Yokohama’s Gift to Japan No single city has had more influence on Japanese ramen culture than Yokohama.
